earlier_sources: https://github.com/itfoundry/kumar at 3192a79a79202eb715d83fd044e9234a6d0dde66: masters/Kumar One.glyphs, one file for both families (masters Filled and Outlined, 847 glyphs, no instances), built with hindkit. It is not the release's source: the release (google/fonts 06463af09, v1.001 hotfix of 2017) has 868 glyphs, 22 of them absent from that file, and maps U+0AF9, which the file does not.
disclose: The release has no glyph instructions: its font program defines functions that no glyph calls, and its control value program sets up the rasterizer without hinting any glyph. These sources carry no TrueType instructions, and the build is hinted by ttfautohint, as for every release that has a font program: the outlines, spacing and layout are the release's, its rendering at small sizes under a TrueType interpreter is not. Hinting is not compared by the gates.
gdef_classes_fea: the release's GDEF classes glyphs no glyph category expresses, so the build without them shapes differently
